outlook.statement: Your directors look forward to improve the financial position of the Company and are optimistic about the future growth and performance of the Company.

The sector in which the Company has been operating is developing faster and provides ample growth opportunities. Further due to rise in foreign direct investment in the sector, Company will be able to develop projects at fast pace and looking forward for better development and high investment returns.

risks: The Company has not developed and implemented any risk management policy as the risk threatening the business activity carried out by the Company during the year are minimal.
Working capital intensive business leading to higher working capital requirements

Material weakness in internal financial controls: documentation in respect of specific policies and procedures and the IT Controls pertaining to internal financial controls over financial reporting are not adequate and needs to be further strengthened.
Audit trail (edit log) facility was not enabled at the database layer to log any direct data changes for all the accounting software used for maintaining the books of account.

In the absence of coverage of audit trail (edit log) with respect to database level in the independent auditor's report in relation to controls at the service organisation for accounting software used for preparation of financial statements, which is operated by a third-party software service provider, unable to comment whether the audit trail feature at the database level of the said software was enabled and operated throughout the year for all relevant transactions recorded in the software.
Company does not have an internal audit system established as required under section 138 of the Companies Act.
